title: SELLAS Life Sciences Presents Positive Phase 2 Data of SLS009 in Combination with AZA/VEN in Relapsed/Refractory AML-MR at ASH 2025
summary: SLS009 in combination with AZA/VEN achieved a 46% overall response rate across all cohorts, a 58% overall response rate in patients with one prior line of therapy, and encouraging survival outcomes in heavily-pretreated AML-MR following prior VEN-based treatment Median overall survival (mOS) of 8.9 months in the least pretreated patient cohort; across all cohorts, mOS was not yet reached in patients with one prior line of therapy vs historical benchmark of approximately 2.5 months SLS009 30 mg IV twice weekly added to AZA/VEN was safe and feasible, with no dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs) observed Study expansion to evaluate SLS009 plus AZA/VEN in newly diagnosed AML with high-risk features is planned for Q1 2026 NEW YORK, Dec. 07, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SELLAS Life Sciences Group, Inc.
